name: ticket-to-pr
description: Take a Jira ticket to a pull request in one manual command: open questions from the ticket and the code asked in one round before work starts, implementation in the current session inside a dedicated worktree of the ticket branch (located by the agent's own worktree rules), pre-review the diff with an independent Claude subagent and/or Codex (confirmed findings fixed, one re-check), commit, push, open the PR, summon the team's PR reviewers (GitHub Copilot, the @claude action), then wait for their reviews and handle every comment (fix in a new commit, reply in each thread), moving the Jira ticket to the profile's statuses before work and after the PR. /ticket-to-pr:done squash-merges the ticket's PR only when it is green (checks passed, no conflicts, no changes requested, no unresolved threads), pinned to the checked commit, then moves the ticket to the profile's final status and removes the branch's worktree and local branch when nothing unmerged is left in them. /ticket-to-pr:deploy rolls the ticket branch out to the contours named in the command through a checklist (fresh master, green CI, build from HEAD, nobody deploying, the user's own lock and no foreign ones, current state recorded for rollback), then health-checks the pods right after and 5 minutes later and reports; any failure stops with a report and nothing is rolled back automatically. /ticket-to-pr:full runs every step the profile enables without questions; /ticket-to-pr:partial shows a checklist to pick the steps. Everything team-specific — Jira site, branch naming, verify commands, pre-review model, commit format, how the PR is created, how each reviewer is summoned, the ticket's status path — lives in a per-team profile under the plugin's data directory, created by /ticket-to-pr:setup and picked by the repo's git remote; an unmapped repo runs setup first. Requires gh and the Atlassian MCP server; codex is optional.; every command logs its own failures to a journal, and journal turns them into fixes of the skill, profile and profile scripts
